verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents its own glTF importer, with a dedicated deep-dive page, and also lists OBJ, STL and .babylon model loading. The evidence never mentions FBX or USD import, so it covers only one of the three formats the story names. The 3ds Max/Maya/Blender exporter plugins are a separate DCC-side export path and are not credited here. Missing for 10: FBX import, USD import, independent or hands-on corroboration that imports come through cleanly.

support.subject: As a technical artist, standard interchange formats — glTF, FBX, USD — import cleanly

citations.quote: Supports multiple file formats including .babylon, glTF, STL, OBJ, and more
